method: Deterministic transcript review against locally authored references. Raw literal alphanumeric-token WER is preserved. A secondary number/time-normalized WER canonicalizes only exact number phrases in these fixtures; it does not correct proper names or ordinary word recognition.

summary.notes: Clip 1 has genuine word errors. Clip 2 reads both numeric identifiers but renders Mira Chen as Merichen; the proper-name error is not normalized away. Clip 3 uses $42 for forty two dollars and 6.15 for six fifteen. This small synthetic sample is not a general ASR quality estimate.

normalization_rules.asr-02: Canonicalize “two zero four eight” and “seven three one” as 2048 and 731. Preserve Mira Chen/Merichen and queue/Q spelling differences as errors. Split Q731 into q and 731 only to expose the numeric component; q vs queue remains an error.
normalization_rules.asr-03: Canonicalize “forty two dollars” and $42 as the same money slot; canonicalize “six fifteen”, 6.15, or 6:15 as the same time slot.
